items.title: ISYF 2027: External Facilitator Recruitment
items.author: Chia Wan Jie
items.description:
Want to be part of the Organising Team of
the 19th International Science Youth Forum (ISYF)?
ISYF brings together youths passionate
about science for days of fun, engaging activities: masterclasses, science
activities and plenty of bonding. As an External Facilitator, you’ll guide
delegates through the programme, from the Amazing Race and science workshops to
keynote lectures and excursions, and help make their experience unforgettable.
Details
on ISYF 2027:
📅
5 Jan - 7 Jan 2027
📍
Hwa Chong Institution
‼️
All facilitators will be staying in Hwa Chong Institution Boarding School from
4 Jan - 7 Jan 2027.
Committees
open for application:
ISYF has 6 working committees, and 3 are open
to External Facilitators:
●
Ceremonies
–
Host the Keynote Lecture and
Closing Dinner
●
Science
Activities –
Plan and execute
all STEM activities
●
Media and Publications –
Video and photography, managing the ISYF website, and
more
Your role as an External Facilitator:
●
Lead and look after delegates
throughout ISYF activities, keeping things safe, fun and on schedule
●
Work alongside the ISYF Organising
Team
Who we’re looking for:
●
JC1 students who are passionate
about STEM
●
Enthusiastic, responsible team
players
●
Able to commit for the entire
duration of ISYF, as well as work sessions and rehearsals in November and
December.
Timeline:
📝 Sign-ups: 12 – 16 Oct
🎤 Interviews: 20 – 22 Oct (please be
available on at least one of these dates))
If you are interested,
please fill in the form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScyb-4kLDe6ymrjUj1q2lFlFIo9C-Oyh5gWcSPSwUunVwC3_A/viewform?usp=header
For any queries, feel
free to GChat Hong Debo (221294x@student.hci.edu.sg) or Tan Yu Ning
(222202a@student.hci.edu.sg). Thank you so much for your interest, and we look
forward to seeing you at ISYF 2027!
Warmest Regards,
Hong Debo and Fu Cai Gui
Co-Chairpersons
ISYF 2027 Student
Organising Committee
